heroes.name: Raya Flint
heroes.specialty: Reliable combos, field repair, and balanced lane control
heroes.weakness: No extreme advantage; must use positioning well
heroes.capability_summary: Balanced mechanic who can handle any wave and recover mistakes.

heroes.name: Kian Vale
heroes.specialty: Crowd control, fast recovery, creature calming, and med patches
heroes.weakness: Lower raw damage; wins through spacing and control
heroes.capability_summary: Technical biologist who controls groups and protects fragile creatures.

heroes.name: Nika Sol
heroes.specialty: Fast movement, aerial pressure, and burst repositioning
heroes.weakness: Low health; bad trades punish her quickly
heroes.capability_summary: Agile scout who turns the arena into a race line.

heroes.name: Tor Bram
heroes.specialty: Armor, throws, shoulder checks, and holding lanes under pressure
heroes.weakness: Slowest hero; can be surrounded if he misses
heroes.capability_summary: Ex-Iron Veil defender who absorbs hits and breaks enemy lines.
